utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Dane — I’m happy to help with book club. What are we sorting out?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Mara, thanks — I’m probably joining a bit late again, but I can help sort out the next book and where we’re meeting.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be great, Dane — thank you. Let’s pick the next book first, then I can help lock in a meeting spot.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — when’s the book club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me check the details first, then I’ll tell you the time.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Okay, thanks — just let me know when you find it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what we’ve got for book club snacks and extra chairs. What’s the plan for tonight?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—tonight’s book club. I think we’re just doing the discussion and whatever snacks you can round up sounds perfect.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll see what snacks and chairs I can pull together before everyone arrives.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’d be happy to hear what the book club is reading this time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I should check the schedule first, since I’m not sure when the next meeting is.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No rush—just let me know when you check it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still meeting Thursday for book club, or did the time change?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not totally sure—I heard there might’ve been a change, but I’d want to double-check before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—can you check and let me know? I don’t want to show up at the wrong time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the book club? I heard they’re picking a new read this week, so I’m curious what everyone lands on.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I’m curious too—if they want, I can bring over a few spare copies from my shelf.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be lovely, Gus — I bet folks would appreciate the extras. I’ll mention it at the meeting and see what they pick!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the book club’s meeting this week—want me to send you the details and invite you too?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, please send the details—I’ll keep an eye on where and when it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll send them over as soon as I have the time and place confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with book club—what should I bring or read up on?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Could you confirm which book we’re discussing and whether I should bring snacks or just notes?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll check which book we picked and let you know—bring notes for now, and snacks if you feel like it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo — I’ve got the book club notes ready, and I’m happy to help plan the next meeting. What book are we discussing?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Rosa — thanks! I’m pretty sure we’re doing the mystery one, but I’ll need to check the exact title.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: No problem — if you check the title, I’ll get the discussion notes lined up and we can go from there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll mention the book club plan to the others and make sure everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. I appreciate it—just let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll keep everyone posted if the book club plan changes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the book club—right, I was meaning to bring that up. Have you picked the next book yet?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Not yet — I’ve been a little behind on things lately, so I haven’t chosen one. If you want, I can send a couple of options tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’d be great, thanks — I’ll keep an eye out tomorrow. And no rush, I’m just glad we’re still doing it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, the book club’s been lovely lately—everyone’s bringing such different takes, which makes it really fun. Have you been reading along?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: A little, yeah—I’ve been trying to keep up between errands. What’s the book this week?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We’re on "The River Knows," and it’s been sparking all sorts of opinions already. If you want, I can bring you a quick recap before the next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the book club? I’d love to bring you along—when are you free?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I usually end up free late in the week—Friday evening works best for me.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Friday evening works great—I’ll send you the details and invite you along.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard the latest book club pick yet—what are you all reading?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We’re reading "The Winter Guest" this month. I can write down the meeting time too, if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, please—I’d appreciate the meeting time. "The Winter Guest" sounds interesting.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds lovely—what time is the book club meeting, and should I work around school pickup?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We’re meeting at 7 on Thursday, so you should be clear of school pickup. If that still feels tight, I can save you a spot and bring you up to speed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, 7 on Thursday works for me—I should be free by then. Please save me a spot, and I’ll catch up with you there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m thinking we could get the book club folks together with Maya’s game night crowd sometime — it might be fun to mix the groups. Have you heard what everyone wants to read next?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, that could be a fun mix. I haven’t heard a firm pick yet, but I can ask around and see what everyone’s leaning toward.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, thanks — if you hear a couple of strong picks, send them my way and I’ll help pull people together.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Pia, book club’s still on for Thursday if you want to swing by. I can bring my extra folding chairs if needed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus — that helps. I just want to make sure there’s enough room and I can get there on time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries — I’ll set the chairs aside and keep a little extra space open for you. If you’re running late, just text me and I’ll make sure you’re covered.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m pretty sure the book club meets at the community center on Maple, but I can double-check if you want.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’d be great, Opal—thank you. I’ll note Maple for now, and your double-check would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll check and let you know for sure as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did we decide which book club title we’re reading next?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I don’t want to guess—let me check our notes first. If you remember the options, send them and I’ll help narrow it down.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I don’t have the options handy either—can you check the notes and tell me what’s listed?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Cleo — happy to help with the book club. What do you need?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — could you check if we have enough snacks and paper cups for the book club?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure — I can check that and let you know if we need to grab more.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I haven’t heard the latest about book club yet — what’s the word from everyone?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, I might’ve missed the latest too — was there a new pick or a change in meeting time?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not sure yet either, but I can ask around and let you know what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are we definitely meeting for book club tonight, or has that changed?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, we’re still on for tonight—same place, same time. I haven’t heard any change yet.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, good—I just wanted to make sure. See you there, then.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, nice — how did the book club go? I’ve been meaning to stop by and hear what everyone’s reading.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It went alright — we kept things small and talked about a mystery novel. You should come by sometime if you feel like it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds lovely — I’d like that. Tell me which mystery novel it was, and I’ll try to make the next one.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the book club! I keep meaning to bring cookies, but I’d better write that down before I forget again.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good idea—write it down now so it’s not forgotten. Cookies would be great.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: You’re right—I’m writing it down now. I’ll bring cookies to the book club, promise.
